elements.description:
The skills a workspace has added, grouped by who made them – search, source and on/off filters, a switch per skill,
Update when a newer version is out, and Add skill.

properties.name: description
properties.description: A quieter line under the heading

properties.name: skills
properties.description: The skills. Changed by the switches unless a tc-enabled-change or tc-skills-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: groups
properties.description: The order of the source groups; groups not named sort after Built-in and Your team, Community last

properties.name: query
properties.description: The search text. Changed by typing unless a tc-query-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: group
properties.description: The source shown, or null for all. Changed by the Source select unless a tc-group-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: show
properties.description: "all", "on" or "off". Changed by the Show select unless a tc-show-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: now
properties.description: The time now, epoch ms, for "3 h ago"; without it, last used shows as a date

properties.name: labels
properties.description: Words to rename, merged over defaultSkillLibraryLabels; {n}, {on}, {name}, {version} and {when} are filled in

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-enabled-change
events.description: A skill's switch was flipped ({ id, enabled, skill }: SkillEnabledChange); cancelable – prevented, the switch stays as it was

events.name: tc-skills-change
events.description: The list changed after a switch ({ skills, id }: SkillLibrarySkillsChange); cancelable – prevented, `skills` stays as it was

events.name: tc-query-change
events.description: The search changed ({ query }: SkillLibraryQueryChange); cancelable – prevented, `query` stays as it was

events.name: tc-group-change
events.description: Another source was picked ({ group }: SkillLibraryGroupChange); cancelable – prevented, `group` stays as it was

events.name: tc-show-change
events.description: All, On or Off was picked ({ show }: SkillLibraryShowChange); cancelable – prevented, `show` stays as it was

events.name: tc-update
events.description: Update was pressed on a skill ({ id, version, skill }: SkillLibraryUpdate)

events.name: tc-add
events.description: Upload, From a URL or Create was picked in Add skill ({ source }: SkillLibraryAdd)

events.name: tc-skill-open
events.description: A skill's name was pressed ({ id, skill }: SkillLibraryOpen)

functions.name: skillGroups
functions.signature: skillGroups(skills: readonly LibrarySkill[], order: readonly string[]): string[]
functions.description: The groups in display order: Built-in, Your team, plugins as they appear, Community

props.name: defaultSkills
props.description: The skills on mount, when `skills` isn't controlled

props.name: onSkillsChange
props.description: Called with the whole list after a switch is flipped, and the skill that changed

props.name: onEnabledChange
props.type: (id: string, enabled: boolean, skill: LibrarySkill) => boolean | void
props.description: A switch was flipped; return false to keep it as it was

props.name: query
props.description: The search text – controlled when given

props.name: defaultQuery
props.description: The search text on mount, when `query` isn't controlled

props.name: onQueryChange
props.description: Called with the search text as it's typed

props.name: group
props.description: The source shown, or null for all – controlled when given

props.name: defaultGroup
props.description: The source on mount, when `group` isn't controlled

props.name: defaultShow
props.description: Which skills show on mount, when `show` isn't controlled

props.name: onShowChange
props.description: Called with All, On or Off as it's picked

props.name: onUpdate
props.type: (id: string, version: string, skill: LibrarySkill) => void
props.description: Update was pressed on a skill: install `version`

props.name: onAdd
props.description: Upload, From a URL or Create was picked in Add skill

props.name: onSkillOpen
props.description: A skill's name was pressed: open its detail

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.
